directionHelp.build: You mark a day when you did it.
directionHelp.quit: You mark a day when you kept your commitment and held off.

directionLocked: The type can't be changed once a day has been marked. Clear every marked day to change it.

schedule.weeklyInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 7.
schedule.effectiveToday: A new schedule applies from today. Earlier days keep the schedule they had.
schedule.effectiveNextMonday: Changes to weekly schedules apply next Monday.

historyHelp: Tap a day to mark or clear it. Days before the start and upcoming days can't be marked.

hintMark.build: Double tap to mark this day as completed.
hintMark.quit: Double tap to mark this day as kept.

a11y.hintClear: Double tap to clear this day.

invalid: Check the title and schedule and try again.

streak.title: Streak
streak.switchLabel: Show a streak for this habit
streak.switchHint: Counts scheduled days kept one after another. Off unless you turn it on, and only on this device.
streak.countBuild_one: {{count}} scheduled day completed in a row
streak.countBuild_other: {{count}} scheduled days completed in a row
streak.countQuit_one: {{count}} scheduled day kept in a row
streak.countQuit_other: {{count}} scheduled days kept in a row
streak.zeroBuild: Streak tracking is on. It starts after a scheduled day is completed.
streak.zeroQuit: Streak tracking is on. It starts after a scheduled day is kept.
streak.ineligible: Streaks are available for habits scheduled on specific days.
streak.ineligibleEnabled: Streak tracking is on for this habit. It shows again when the habit is scheduled on specific days.

summary.scheduled_one: {{done}} of {{count}} scheduled commitment recorded so far
summary.scheduled_other: {{done}} of {{count}} scheduled commitments recorded so far

empty.week: No habit activity recorded this week.
empty.month: No habit activity recorded this month.
